title: bonsai.labels/1
description: Label definitions (contract §5.2): what each label in one namespace means, what kind of value it takes and who may write it. A YAML definition file, written by a pack (or attached on the machine, contract §5.3); read by Bonsai (bonsai check checks every label value against its definition; the guard reads granting labels), agents (they see each description) and the studio. A definition may be added, never redefined (contract §5.1). A writer writes every field below, in this order, null or [] where it does not apply (contract §2.2); a reader treats a missing field as null (grants: as false) and keeps an unknown one. The file follows the format-1 YAML rules (contract §2.4), and as a pack file it documents itself in # comments (contract §2.8).

format.description: The version line, always the first key (contract §2.2).

namespace.description: The namespace every label here belongs to: bonsai for Bonsai and the packs it publishes, a pack's own id for any other pack (contract §5.1).

version.description: The definer's own version of this set; it only grows, as definitions are only added (contract §5.2).

examples.name: workflow.owner
examples.description: The role that works on this task.

name.description: The label's full name, <namespace>.<name> with one dot, in this file's namespace (contract §5.1).

kind.description: The kind of value (contract §5.2), a closed list: choice (one of values), text (one line; optional pattern and max), number (an integer or a decimal), list (a list of items).

values.description: For kind choice: the allowed values. [] for every other kind.

items.description: For kind list: the kind of each item, text or number (contract §5.2, §5.6). null for every other kind.

pattern.description: For kind text: an optional regular expression the value must match (contract §5.6's bonsai.branch has one). null when there is none, and for every other kind.

max.description: For kind text: an optional most characters, up to 300 (contract §5.2). null when there is none, and for every other kind.

kinds.description: Which document kinds may carry the label (contract §7.3): task, run, state, or a kind a pack declares. Named kinds, not on: a YAML 1.1 reader takes that key as true.

set_by.description: Who writes the value, a closed list (contract §5.2, §5.4): agent (agents write it in the file) or outside (agents never write it; a program outside agent sessions does).

grants.description: true when the value grants a right (contract §5.5; today only bonsai.allows); false otherwise. A reader takes a missing grants as false.

description.description: One line, at most 200 characters: what agents see about the label (contract §5.2).
